expected_level_description: You can: - understand and help teams to apply a range of techniques to analyse data and provide insight - be proactive and present compelling findings that inform wider decisions - apply innovative approaches to resolve problems

You can: - turn complex data into compelling, clear and actionable stories - share data communication skills with the team and across government - present analysis and visualisations in clear ways to communicate complex messages - communicate negative and positive information to stakeholders - give tactical and strategic recommendations

You can: - lead the development of performance measurement frameworks including Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) - demonstrate a deep understanding of business goals and can turn these into tangible performance measures

skill: Quality assurance of data and analysis
expected_level_description: You can: - set up a system to get data ready for use - specify how data should be cleansed and prepared - bring data together from different sources - communicate the limitations of data
You can: - show a deep understanding of the technical concepts required for the role and understand how they fit into the wider technical landscape - understand the limitations of digital technology

skill: Understanding analysis across the product life cycle
expected_level_description: You can: - apply experience in multiple parts of the product life cycle - recognise when to move forward and when to stop - recognise the appropriate deliverables and engage the right people to meet them - work with other Agile delivery disciplines throughout the product life cycle - plan and proactively engage with stakeholders at the appropriate stage of the project - identify which tools and techniques should be used at each stage

You can: - understand the difference between user needs and desires of the user - demonstrate experience in meeting user needs across a variety of channels - integrate digital analytics with qualitative data, such as user surveys and user research, to develop hypotheses for testing - offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use

You can: - work with and challenge senior stakeholders - prioritise and mitigate constraints and can turn them into an advantage - adapt the approach according to constraints - demonstrate a good knowledge of security and data privacy

You can: - analyse how a service fits into care pathways across organisations - work with clinicians, care staff, and patients to shape digital services - explain the effect of digital decisions on care, safety, and staff workload
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - define data quality rules and measures - work with data providers to fix the root causes of poor quality
You can: - work with pseudonymised data and apply disclosure checks before releasing outputs - recognise when linked or detailed data could identify a patient
You can: - recognise and challenge behaviour that excludes others - consider different needs when you plan your work
